title: Nether Template
body:
![The best armor you'll get](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff1950e8184daf7904867c66113faf2d2d5ccf80_0.webp)
The resource pack adds a new type of netherite armor to Minecraft, or rather, a new, more pleasant template in blue shades





![WithRP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0917f28ad74c9b54a53e26be8a55128ca14705c3.png)

![Changes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c4406729b154d5f5a6d6f5107e8ae28c83a8c0f_0.webp)

![WithoutRP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c246c6759c82df33cc4e08361c6a1337204f525a.png)

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――


Features:

- Works on versions before the templates were added.

- The template has a blue gradient

- To install, place it in the resourcespack folder, then open the resource pack and select it

If you're looking for a texture pack that slightly reworks armor. Nether Templete is the perfect choice for you. It provides a pleasant and clear gaming experience without changing the original Minecraft feel.
